brief:
Since the start of Operation Al-Aqsa Flood, occupation forces have launched a brutal assault on Palestinians in Gaza while Palestinian resistance fighters battle in the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The Israeli occupation apparatus is attempting to portray itself as having suppressed the operation through what it describes as efforts against the central cause at stake.

The report indicates the Al-Aqsa Mosque and broader Jerusalem issues remain pivotal to Palestinian resistance activity despite the intensive military campaign underway in Gaza.

title: Al-Aqsa remains central issue amid Gaza war
